create_smolvlm_conditional_generation: create a SmolVLM model for conditional image-to-text generation with a vision encoder and language model head
run_smolvlm_image_feature_extraction: run the SmolVLM model to extract image features from pixel values using the vision transformer and connector
build_smolvlm_multimodal_forward: build a forward pass for SmolVLM that merges image hidden states with text token embeddings for multimodal input
test_smolvlm_vision_attention: test the SmolVLMVisionAttention module that implements multi-headed self-attention with variable image resolution support
review_smolvlm_inputs_merger: review the SmolVLM inputs_merger method that combines image embeddings with text token embeddings at image token positions
